instruction: Review PLAN.md, the implementation plan for FEATURE.md, before it is executed (spec.md explains the setup; the code is in src/ and test/). Do not change any file except the one you write. Write PLAN-REVIEW.json in this directory: a JSON array with one object per defect that would make the plan fail, miss an acceptance criterion or do unrequested work, each {"step": <step number, or null when no step applies>, "ac": "<AC id, or null>", "kind": "uncovered-ac|missing-file|bad-order|no-verification|scope-creep|other", "issue": "<what is wrong and the fix>"}. Write [] if the plan has no defects.
